headline: Singer Mark From NCT Announces Upcoming Solo Studio Album Windmill
seoTitle: Mark Announces Upcoming Solo Studio Album Windmill
metaDescription: Former NCT member Mark is set to release his full-length album Windmill next month, featuring tracks he co-wrote and helped design visually.
aiSummaryBullets: The former NCT member Mark will release his new studio album titled Windmill next month.
The upcoming album includes the lead single What’s Your Dream? Don’t Have One and previously released B-sides.
Mark participated in the songwriting, composition, and visual direction of the project released through Upper Room.
aiContextParagraph: The South Korean music industry has confirmed upcoming releases for several major acts as the year concludes and a new one begins. Mark, a former member of the boy group NCT, is preparing for his first full-length solo album titled Windmill, which is scheduled for release next month under his agency, Upper Room. The project features a total of three confirmed tracks, including the main single What’s Your Dream? Don’t Have One and two previously released songs, My Friend and Happiest. Mark was actively involved in the creative process, contributing to both the lyrical and melodic aspects of the production as well as the album's visual branding. Simultaneously, the K-pop boy group Zerobaseone has announced plans to return with a new musical project scheduled for release in January.
whyItIsViral: This story is generating moderate engagement following reports from two national media outlets regarding upcoming major K-pop releases.
